Soojin / Emma — I ran the first full sweep this morning and attached perf_results_v1.csv. Quick notes on what you'll find in the CSV and dashboard:

- Columns: test_id, model, quant, concurrency, tokens_per_sec, median_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, p99_latency_ms, ttft_ms_cold, ttft_ms_warm, error_rate_pct, run_notes
- Concurrency tested: 1, 5, 25, 100 (steady-state measured after 2 warmup minutes)
- TTFT: measured as time from HTTP request start to first token output; cold = after model cold start (cache flush), warm = after KV cache warm-up
- Environment: us-west-2, A100-80GB, Redwood runtime v2.4.1 (kernel selection tuned for threads)

Preliminary highlights:
  - 7B variant: P95 latency stays < 220ms at concurrency 5; throughput scales ~x4 moving 1->5; TTFT cold ~420ms, warm ~110ms
  - 13B variant: P95 latency ~480ms at concurrency 5; throughput linear-ish to 25, tails widen at 100 concurrent requests (error_rate ~0.8% transient)

I uploaded raw traces and run configs here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BxyzMAP (access granted to FinLytics/aws domain). Interactive dashboard (read-only) is at: https://redwood.app/dashboards/finlytics/perf-2026-06?token=REDACTED
